assumptions: Paired observations: Each query is evaluated under candidate and baseline configurations on identical corpus candidates.
Sample independence: 20 answerable test queries evaluate distinct CS topics across 13 disciplines.
Continuous bounded differences: nDCG delta d_i in [-1, +1]; sampling distribution of mean difference d_bar approximated as Student-t via CLT.

retrieval_metric_coexistence_proof.reason: Macro-averaging over multi-target evaluation queries where |Relevant| > 1 bounds Recall@1 to 1 / |Relevant| = 0.500 while MRR achieves 1.000 because rank 1 contains a relevant chunk.

reranker_architectural_recommendation.multi_hop_benefit: Promotes secondary relevant chunks for complex multi-hop queries (+0.0694 on TCP/CORS, +0.0528 on B+ Trees/Paging).
reranker_architectural_recommendation.single_hop_risk: Can slightly reorder already-optimal rank 1 candidates on single-hop queries (e.g., eval-test-ans-01 delta -0.3691).
reranker_architectural_recommendation.production_guidance: Reranker must remain configurable via feature flag (ENABLE_RERANKER=true/false) or query-intent routing rather than being deployed unconditionally.

activation_record_case_reconciliation.subject: Programming Fundamentals
activation_record_case_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: The ranking output, candidate pool, ground-truth labels, and metric code for eval-test-ans-01 have NEVER changed: Dense placed the target recursion chunk at rank 1 (nDCG = 1.0000), while Cross-Encoder placed a related stack-vs-heap chunk at rank 1 and the target recursion chunk at rank 2 (nDCG = 1.0 / log2(3) = 0.6309), yielding an exact per-query delta of -0.3691. The value -0.2625 cited in Phase 12.1.2 prose was a typographical transcription slip where an earlier rough aggregate subtraction sum across all 20 test queries (20 * (-0.013125) = -0.2625) was inadvertently cited as the per-query delta for eval-test-ans-01.

four_non_zero_reranker_differences.reconciliation_of_cited_sum: The value -0.2625 cited in earlier reports was a typographical transcription slip for the true paired sum -0.2616 (-0.26162697). In the authoritative benchmark, the unrounded macro-averaged aggregate means are 0.95430264 (Cross-Encoder) and 0.96738399 (Dense-Only), whose difference is exactly -0.01308135. This matches the paired per-query mean difference (-0.26162697 / 20 = -0.01308135) to within 1e-16 machine precision. The hypothetical aggregate difference 0.954275 - 0.967400 = -0.013125 (discrepancy ~0.00004365) was an erroneous post-hoc back-calculation in Phase 12.1.3 prose when dividing -0.2625 by 20, rather than the true aggregate score calculation.

paired_statistical_reconciliation.explanation: Binary and graded paired mean deltas differ across all four comparisons due to multi-target queries (eval-test-ans-13, 14, 15) receiving graded weights (3 and 2): Keyword (+0.0095 Binary vs +0.0101 Graded, diff +0.0006), Simple Union (+0.0043 Binary vs +0.0045 Graded, diff +0.0002), Hybrid RRF (+0.0048 Binary vs +0.0052 Graded, diff +0.0004), and Cross-Encoder (-0.0143 Binary vs -0.0131 Graded, diff +0.0012). Crucially, under BOTH formulations, NO retrieval configuration achieves statistical significance (all p > 0.18; all 95% and 98.75% Bonferroni confidence intervals bracket zero).

audit_notes.corpus_sharing: Corpus of 31 academic curriculum chunks is shared across DEV, VAL, and TEST. Queries and evaluation cases are strictly partitioned with 0 question overlap.
audit_notes.retrieval_significance: No paired retrieval differences achieved statistical significance (p > 0.20 across all 4 comparisons vs dense baseline).
